messages:
sam (releases): quick heads-up: nightly canary showed higher cold-start latency for quant-v2 on runtime 2.15.0 in ap-southeast. proposing a targeted model pin to quant-v1 for the canary cohort while we hotfix. thoughts? :thinking_face:

arun (mlops): saw that too. the quant-v2 instances spike at first token for ~3s on small requests. inference profiles point at kernel scheduling jitter after the new fused-attn change. model pin seems reasonable to reduce customer impact.

nina (runtime): ping @arun can you confirm if this is kernel scheduling or memory mapping? if it's mmap path we might need a runtime patch. Either way a model fallback avoids immediate user impact.

josh (sdk): we should avoid surprising SDK users. If we change default model routing, we need a note in release notes and maybe a header in responses indicating fallback. Can deploybot add a user-visible flag?

sre-liz: agree with model pin for minimal blast radius. telemetry owners: set thresholds: 95p cold-start < 500ms and 99p cold-start < 1s for canary. If breach, auto-abort. Also capture kernel thread preemption samples.

devops-oliver: operational notes: we'll reserve +15% capacity in ap-southeast for the canary to avoid noisy neighbor effects. Also recommend scheduling during low-traffic window 01:30-07:30 local.

deploy-bot: Automated analysis: diff attached. quant-v2 shows 2.8s median cold-start vs 0.6s for quant-v1 over 30m. Suggested action: pin model quant-v2 -> quant-v1 for cohort "canary-apac" at 01:45 UTC. Command ready.

sam (releases): proposed runbook: 1) schedule pin at 01:45 UTC for canary-apac, 2) monitor cold-start and evictions for 40m, 3) if stable, roll to blended traffic with stagger 5m, 4) open issue for runtime kernel fix and plan rollforward when kernel-2.15.1 is validated.

arun (mlops): I'll run a focused repro with mmap instrumentation on quant-v2 at scale to reproduce. ETA 30m.

nina (runtime): if repro shows mmap we can ship kernel-2.15.1 quick patch. prefer rollforward to new runtime only after validation. For now model pin is least risky.

josh (sdk): drafting small release note: "Temporarily routing quant-v2 traffic to quant-v1 in ap-southeast canary due to elevated cold-starts; engineers triaging." I'll push to release-notes/drafts. Add me if messaging escalates.

sre-liz: abort criteria: if 95p cold-start > 1.2s or eviction_rate delta > 0.05% vs baseline abort and unpin model. I'll wire a PagerDuty trigger to the oncall if abort happens.

devops-oliver: runbook snippet:
```bash
# pin model for canary cohort
deploybot pin model quant-v2 --to quant-v1 --region ap-southeast --cohort canary-apac --schedule 01:45UTC --stagger 0m
# monitor 40m, rollback command:
deploybot unpin model quant-v2 --reason "auto-abort"
```

sam (releases): approvals needed: @nina, @arun, @josh, @sre-liz. please reply with :white_check_mark: if good.

arun (mlops): :white_check_mark: will post repro logs.

nina (runtime): :white_check_mark: approve. will standby for kernel trace.

josh (sdk): :white_check_mark: noted on release notes and header flag.

sre-liz: :white_check_mark: alerting in place. oncall alerted.

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: `pin model quant-v2 -> quant-v1` at 01:45 UTC (ap-southeast, cohort: canary-apac). Will post metric snapshot at 02:30 UTC.

sam (releases): good work. if metrics look green at 02:30 we'll promote to blended with 5m ramp. otherwise rollback and escalate to runtime for rollforward. I'll write a short bulletin for #customer-impact if needed.

arun (mlops): repro started now, posting traces to the thread once collected.

josh (sdk): small note: clients using explicit model param will be unaffected; only default routing changes. adding that to the blurb.

sre-liz: metric snapshot will include cold-start histograms pre/post, eviction deltas, and kernel thread traces link.

sam (releases): thanks all  moving to execute. :rocket:
